cards.title: 1. Principle of Summation
cards.subtitle: All price action is the direct sum of individual cycle waves

cards.title: 2. Principle of Harmonicity
cards.subtitle: Neighboring waves are related by simple integer multiples (usually 2)

cards.title: 3. Principle of Synchronicity
cards.subtitle: Different cycle lengths bottom simultaneously at shared turning points

cards.title: 4. Principle of Proportionality
cards.subtitle: Cycles with longer periods naturally command larger amplitudes
